'''Junker's Junction''' was the engineering area within the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Mek-Sha]] in [[3627 BBY]]. It was controlled by the [[Engineer/Legends|chief engineer]] [[Junker Jott]] and his [[Junker Jott's crew|crew]].<ref name="Junker's Junction" />
